create_openai_client: create an OpenAI client configured with the HuggingFace router base URL and HF_TOKEN
create_chat_completion_stream: create a streaming chat completion with multimodal text and image input using the OpenAI client
iterate_stream_chunks: iterate over streamed response chunks and print delta content incrementally
send_multimodal_message: send a multimodal message with text and image URL to a vision language model
configure_hf_inference_model: configure a HuggingFace inference model endpoint for streaming vision-language completions
